metaDescription: Order custom poly propylene measuring cups for your business. Perfect for giveaways and kitchen use. Get started with Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Poly propylene measuring cups offer a durable, lightweight alternative to glass or metal. They resist cracks and stains, making them ideal for trade shows, corporate kitchens, or safety departments that need reusable, dishwasher-safe tools. The 32 oz Measurement Mug, for example, provides a generous capacity for mixing or portioning. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or pad printing for a crisp, long-lasting imprint that stands up to frequent use.
